description: This file defines the TaxRateService interface which provides method signatures for retrieving tax rates based on different criteria within a sales management system.

classes.name: TaxRateService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService for managing TaxRate entities, with methods to retrieve tax rates by store, location, and code.
